sets.context:

| Category | Q1 ord | Q1 ret% | Q2 ord | Q2 ret% | Q3 ord | Q3 ret% | Q4 ord | Q4 ret% |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Electronics | 120 | 8 | 150 | 10 | 180 | 12 | 200 | 15 |
| Fashion | 200 | 15 | 220 | 18 | 250 | 20 | 300 | 25 |
| Grocery | 300 | 2 | 320 | 3 | 350 | 3 | 400 | 4 |
| Home | 80 | 5 | 100 | 6 | 120 | 7 | 150 | 8 |

questions.prompt: How many units (in thousands) were returned in Q4 across all four categories?
questions.solution: 1. Electronics: 200*0.15 = 30. 2. Fashion: 300*0.25 = 75. 3. Grocery: 400*0.04 = 16. 4. Home: 150*0.08 = 12. 5. Total = 133 thousand. Answer A.

questions.prompt: Which category had the highest overall return rate across all four quarters?

questions.prompt: Which category received the most orders across all four quarters combined?

questions.prompt: How many Q4 ordered units (in thousands) were kept by customers, i.e. not returned?

sets.context:
Quarterly electricity consumption (in MWh) by four sectors:

| Sector | Q1 | Q2 | Q3 | Q4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Industry | 450 | 480 | 520 | 550 |
| Domestic | 300 | 320 | 380 | 350 |
| Commercial | 150 | 180 | 200 | 220 |
| Agriculture | 100 | 120 | 100 | 130 |

explanations: Correct. Agriculture grew (130-100)/100 = 30% in Q4, ahead of Commercial (10%), Industry (5.77%) while Domestic shrank.
Incorrect. Commercial grew (220-200)/200 = 10% - less than Agriculture.
Incorrect. Industry grew only (550-520)/520 = 5.77%.
Incorrect. Domestic SHRANK (350-380)/380 = -7.89% in Q4.
questions.prompt: Which sector recorded the highest percentage growth in consumption in Q4 over Q3?
questions.solution: 1. Industry: 30/520 = 5.77%. Domestic: -30/380 = -7.89%. Commercial: 20/200 = 10%. Agriculture: 30/100 = 30%. 2. Highest is Agriculture. Answer A.

explanations: Incorrect. 20% is the Q1-to-Q3 growth (200/1000), not Q1-to-Q4.
Incorrect. 12.5% halves the true figure.
Incorrect. 30% is Agriculture's single-sector rate, not the total.
questions.prompt: By what percentage did total consumption grow from Q1 to Q4?

explanations: Incorrect. Domestic totalled 1350 - second highest.
Incorrect. Commercial totalled only 750.
Incorrect. Agriculture totalled only 450 - the least.
Correct. Industry totalled 2000 (450+480+520+550), the most.
questions.prompt: Which sector consumed the most electricity across all four quarters combined?
questions.solution: 1. Industry: 2000. Domestic: 1350. Commercial: 750. Agriculture: 450. 2. Most is Industry, option D. Answer D.

questions.prompt: In which quarter was domestic consumption the lowest?
questions.solution: 1. Domestic: Q1 300, Q2 320, Q3 380, Q4 350. 2. Lowest is Q1. Answer C.
